prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE new high-fidelity flat UI board with exactly THREE independent local component panels A, B, C, never one simultaneous app screen. Small A/B/C labels OUTSIDE the product. These existing DooKnow owner-only widgets use normal readable Chinese text, flat white/light-gray surfaces, #272b3a text, #657084 secondary, #e6e9f1 borders, cobalt #4566c6 accents, restrained8px corners. No device/browser shell or app navigation. Keep generous legibility; no gradients, illustrations, marketing copy, code/API/state labels. All UI wording below verbatim.

A: ONLY the actual compact collection-updated status strip. Exact text "笔记列表有更新" and one enabled small neutral button "刷新列表". A subtle blue-tinted strip is enough. No title, icon, cards, page count, other toolbar or loading button. This is updated=true, not refreshing.

B: Full existing native link-edit card dialog, title "编辑链接", actual close X at top right. Three vertically stacked plain text inputs with labels in exact order:
"显示文字" value "示例链接";
"链接地址" value "ftp://example.invalid";
"标题" EMPTY input with no invented placeholder.
Directly underneath the URL input, before the 标题 field, show the actual small plain inline RED error text "请输入有效的链接地址". No error icon/boxed alert, no additional help or required stars.
At bottom real buttons in order "取消" then "保存链接". 保存链接 is ENABLED blue primary despite inline error, because this actual source validates on click. Do not gray/disable it. Fields remain editable. Do not add protocol selectors, HEX/color controls, eye/clear icons, preview or extra actions.

C: Two separate small alternatives of the SAME existing large-file parent ERROR alert, one below the other, with tiny1/2 OUTSIDE each to show alternatives. This is not two simultaneous alerts. Use ordinary Naive-style pale red error alert with its error-status icon at LEFT, no dismiss X at right.
First variant: exact message "请求失败" followed within the same alert content by one normal enabled neutral button "核对保存结果".
Second variant: same exact message "请求失败" and NO button.
No modal/dialog title, no close/save/retry control, no editable request ID or protocol metadata. Preserve natural wrapping and clear button hit area. These are parent alerts, not errors drawn inside the unsaved-fragment leave dialog; do not draw the whole parent page or another confirmation.

Keep A/B/C visually separate and readable. Any external framing is comparison guidance, not a new application card workflow. Each real control is exactly listed above; no invented action, online/success claim or hidden field. This board supplements existing complete page/modal designs, so no repeated notebook/toolbar/whole-window backdrop.

verification.limitation: The tool does not expose a per-call model identity receipt.

selfInspection.method: Actual native PNG visually checked against exact Collection/Link/LargeFile templates and global preflight missing controls
checks: A exact status/refresh, no stale footer or invented count
B three real labels/inputs with inline URL error before title field, no HEX guard; Save enabled
C parent alert has conditional check action only when requestId exists; no new close/retry/confirmation
implementationNotes: Use actual flat palette and source component scales; raster texture/large framing is illustrative
Naive error status icon must come from existing NAlert, not a custom dismiss control
Large-file alert is behind the unchanged leave modal in that guarded state; clickability is not asserted through modal scrim
limitations: Source-derived state examples only; no runtime/action/focus/scroll verification
No claim every variant is simultaneously visible or all source states were pictured here
